title: Settings + Preferences Catalog — Global Settings, Layers, UI ~265 Schemas
description: Generate parameter schemas for hyperMILL global settings and preferences: calculation settings (~20 params), display settings (~25), layer system (~15 per layer × N), tool database settings (~15), NC generation settings (~20), machine settings (~30), VIRTUAL Machining settings (~15), measurement system (~10), nightSHIFT batch config (~10), UI features/job list management (~90 non-parameter interactions mapped to parameter equivalents), and user preference profiles. These are the least physics-intensive but most user-facing parameters.

reference: hyperMILL training manuals (settings, preferences, UI configuration sections)

forge_triple.hook: measurementSystemConsistencyHook — BUILT — blocks mixed metric/imperial parameters
forge_triple.action: generate_settings_catalog — BUILT — generates settings domain artifacts from schemas
forge_triple.skill: /hypermill-settings-params — BUILT — settings and preferences parameter reference

sessions.title: System Settings Parameter Schemas (~175 params)
knowledge: Calculation settings: tolerance, smoothing_tolerance, geometry_check, parallel_calculation
Tool database settings: default_TDB_path, auto_load, coupling_type, material_table
NC generation settings: output_folder, naming_convention, sub_programs, line_numbers
Machine settings: machine_model, kinematic_config, axis_limits, spindle_config
Measurement system: metric/inch, decimal_places, angle_format, coordinate_display
sessions.intent: Generate schemas for all system-level settings parameters. Measurement system consistency hook prevents mixed metric/imperial values across parameters. Machine settings validation against MachineRegistry. Calculation tolerance range validation for reasonable machining tolerances.

units.title: Calculation + Machine + NC Generation Settings Schemas — ~70 parameters
units.description: Generate schemas for calculation settings (tolerance 0.001-0.1mm, smoothing_tolerance, geometry_check on/off, parallel_calculation threads — 20 params), machine settings (machine_model from MachineRegistry, kinematic_config, axis_limits per axis, spindle_config max_rpm/min_rpm/power_kw — 30 params), and NC generation settings (output_folder, naming_convention with template variables, sub_program support, line_number format — 20 params). Calculation tolerance hook warns when tolerance < 0.001mm (unrealistic) or > 0.1mm (too coarse).
units.four_loop: BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP
exit_criteria: Calculation schemas: >= 18 parameters with tolerance range validation
Machine schemas: >= 28 parameters linked to MachineRegistry
NC generation schemas: >= 18 parameters with naming convention templates
Tolerance range hook warns on unrealistic values
Unit tests for tolerance range and machine axis limit validation

units.title: Tool DB + Display + Measurement + VIRTUAL + nightSHIFT Schemas — ~105 parameters
units.description: Generate schemas for tool database settings (default_TDB_path, auto_load, coupling_type, material_table — 15 params), display settings (shading, wireframe, transparency, colors, mesh_quality — 25 params), measurement system (metric/inch toggle, decimal_places, angle_format, coordinate_display — 10 params), VIRTUAL Machining settings (simulation_quality, collision_tolerance, stock_mesh_density — 15 params), and nightSHIFT batch config (max_parallel, priority, notification, auto_post — 10 params). Measurement system consistency hook blocks mixed metric/imperial across all parameters in a session.
units.four_loop: BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP
exit_criteria: Tool DB schemas: >= 14 parameters with path validation
Measurement system schemas: >= 9 parameters with consistency hook
Measurement system hook blocks inch values when session is metric and vice versa

sessions.exit_gate: ✓ >= 170 system settings schemas | ✓ measurement consistency hook | ✓ tolerance range hook | omega_floor >= 0.90

sessions.title: UI Features + Settings Artifact Batch Generation (~90 UI mappings + artifacts)
knowledge: Job list management: drag-reorder, group, expand/collapse, filter, multi-select
Tree navigation: component tree, feature tree, operation tree, tool tree
Selection modes, view controls, context menus, drag-and-drop, keyboard shortcuts
All system settings schemas from S1
sessions.intent: Map UI features (non-parameter interactions) to parameter equivalents where applicable, generate schemas for UI configuration parameters, and then batch-generate all settings domain artifacts (skills, scripts, hooks).

units.title: UI Feature Parameter Mapping + Schemas — ~90 parameters
units.description: Map non-parameter UI features to configurable parameter equivalents: job list management (sort_order, group_by, filter_type, display_mode — 15 params), tree navigation (default_tree_view, auto_expand_level, show_icons — 12 params), selection modes (default_selection_mode, selection_highlight_color — 10 params), view controls (default_view_orientation, auto_fit, section_plane_mode — 10 params), context menus (custom_menu_items, shortcut_overrides — 20 params), drag-and-drop (drag_sensitivity, drop_target_highlight — 8 params), keyboard shortcuts (shortcut_map entries — 15 params).
units.four_loop: BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP
exit_criteria: UI feature mapping covers all 7 UI categories (job list, tree, selection, view, context, DnD, shortcuts)
Total settings domain reaches >= 260 parameter schemas
Unit tests for shortcut key validation and view orientation enums

units.title: Settings Domain Artifact Batch Generation — ~265 skills + scripts + hooks
units.description: Artifact generation for the entire settings/preferences domain. Reads all ~265 parameter schemas and auto-generates skill templates, AC Python setter scripts for configurable settings, and hook validation rules. Registers measurement consistency, tolerance range, and machine settings validation hooks.
units.four_loop: BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP
exit_criteria: Skill templates generated for all ~265 settings parameters
AC Python setter scripts generated for configurable parameters
>= 3 hooks registered for settings domain (measurement, tolerance, machine)
tsc --noEmit passes with 0 errors on all generated artifacts

sessions.exit_gate: ✓ >= 260 total settings schemas | ✓ ~265 skills + scripts | ✓ >= 3 hooks | ✓ tsc clean | omega_floor >= 0.90
